snippet.title: AHANAR - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Ahanar is an interactive experience about a fictional (hopefully) town in Buryatia where all men were mobilized and none came back. Now Russia sends random men there and the women aren't having it. 

The game is split into three sections covering different generations of Ahanar women: GenZ Dari-Zhab, GenX Mayor of Ahanar, and Primordial [REDACTED] of Ahanar mountains. None of them are having a good time.

CW: This is an anti-war project and as such deals with hard topics of oppression, racism, warmongering, power abuse, homophobia. 

Out now on: https://all-worms.itch.io/ahanar
